principles: Portable workspace packages do not provision accounts or authenticate institutions.
Preparation, evidence review, and publication approval remain distinct human responsibilities.
Reviewer queues and annotations are collaboration aids, not automated judgments.
Import compatibility does not establish source authority, accuracy, or trust.
Private credentials, member identities, personal contact fields, and sessions are excluded from portable public-safe packages.
Automatic evidence approval, automatic publication, and automatic remote delivery remain disabled.
The public platform does not require paid multi-tenant infrastructure; storage adapters remain optional deployment concerns.
